snippet.title: WEJbA: We Exist Just to be Alive - Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the first trailer for the video game WEJbA, a mixed-media game that uses real handmade plushies for the characters!

Now available: https://isoplod.itch.io/wejba-we-exist-just-to-be-alive
